diff --git a/debian/patches/crypto-config.patch b/debian/patches/crypto-config.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ec6c0d9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/crypto-config.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+From 6be50672543aa5225df4f74115488194dbce37d0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Adrien Nader <adrien.nader@canonical.com>
+Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2024 11:58:20 +0200
+Subject: [PATCH] configuration: also load /etc/gnutls/crypto-configuration.
+Forwarded: no
+
+This enables the integration of gnutls in the crypto-config framework which is
+hosted at https://github.com/canonical/crypto-config . Gnutls will follow the
+configuration provided by the current crypto-config profile if present (there
+is no error if no such file exists).
+
+---
+ lib/priority.c | 50 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++--------------------
+ 1 file changed, 30 insertions(+), 20 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/lib/priority.c b/lib/priority.c
+index 3434619aa..bcde3b155 100644
+--- a/lib/priority.c
++++ b/lib/priority.c
+@@ -1503,12 +1503,13 @@ static inline int cfg_apply(struct cfg *cfg, struct ini_ctx *ctx)
+ 
+ /* This function parses the global section of the configuration file.
+  */
+-static int global_ini_handler(void *ctx, const char *section, const char *name,
++static int global_ini_handler(void *_ctx, const char *section, const char *name,
+ 			      const char *value)
+ {
+ 	char *p;
+ 	char str[MAX_ALGO_NAME];
+-	struct cfg *cfg = ctx;
++	struct ini_ctx *ctx = _ctx;
++	struct cfg *cfg = &ctx->cfg;
+ 
+ 	if (section != NULL && c_strcasecmp(section, GLOBAL_SECTION) == 0) {
+ 		if (c_strcasecmp(name, "override-mode") == 0) {
+@@ -2229,18 +2231,15 @@ update_system_wide_priority_string(void)
+ /* Returns false on parse error, otherwise true.
+  * The system_wide_config must be locked for writing.
+  */
+-static inline bool load_system_priority_file(void)
++static inline bool load_system_priority_file(struct ini_ctx *ctx, const char *file)
+ {
+ 	int err;
+ 	FILE *fp;
+-	struct ini_ctx ctx;
+ 
+-	cfg_init(&system_wide_config);
+-
+-	fp = fopen(system_priority_file, "re");
++	fp = fopen(file, "re");
+ 	if (fp == NULL) {
+ 		_gnutls_debug_log("cfg: unable to open: %s: %d\n",
+-				  system_priority_file, errno);
++				  file, errno);
+ 		return true;
+ 	}
+ 
+@@ -2249,26 +2248,20 @@ static inline bool load_system_priority_file(void)
+ 	 * and then the other sections,
+ 	 * because the [global] section modifies the parsing behavior.
+ 	 */
+-	ini_ctx_init(&ctx);
+-	err = ini_parse_file(fp, global_ini_handler, &ctx);
++	err = ini_parse_file(fp, global_ini_handler, ctx);
+ 	if (!err) {
+ 		if (fseek(fp, 0L, SEEK_SET) < 0) {
+-			_gnutls_debug_log("cfg: unable to rewind: %s\n",
+-					  system_priority_file);
++			_gnutls_debug_log("cfg: unable to rewind: %s\n", file);
+ 			if (fail_on_invalid_config)
+ 				exit(1);
+ 		}
+-		err = ini_parse_file(fp, cfg_ini_handler, &ctx);
++		err = ini_parse_file(fp, cfg_ini_handler, ctx);
+ 	}
+ 	fclose(fp);
+ 	if (err) {
+-		ini_ctx_deinit(&ctx);
+-		_gnutls_debug_log("cfg: unable to parse: %s: %d\n",
+-				  system_priority_file, err);
++		_gnutls_debug_log("cfg: unable to parse: %s: %d\n", file, err);
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+-	cfg_apply(&system_wide_config, &ctx);
+-	ini_ctx_deinit(&ctx);
+ 	return true;
+ }
+ 
+@@ -2318,9 +2311,26 @@ static int _gnutls_update_system_priorities(bool defer_system_wide)
+ 			(system_priority_last_mod == sb.st_mtime);
+ 
+ 	if (!system_priority_file_loaded) {
+-		config_parse_error = !load_system_priority_file();
+-		if (config_parse_error)
++		struct ini_ctx ctx;
++		/* check order of the two below */
++		cfg_init(&system_wide_config);
++		ini_ctx_init(&ctx);
++		config_parse_error =
++			!load_system_priority_file(&ctx, system_priority_file);
++		if (config_parse_error) {
++			ini_ctx_deinit(&ctx);
++			goto out;
++		}
++		config_parse_error =
++			!load_system_priority_file(&ctx,
++						   "/var/lib/crypto-config/profiles/current/gnutls.conf");
++		if (config_parse_error) {
++			ini_ctx_deinit(&ctx);
+ 			goto out;
++		}
++		cfg_apply(&system_wide_config, &ctx);
++		ini_ctx_deinit(&ctx);
++
+ 		_gnutls_debug_log("cfg: loaded system config %s mtime %lld\n",
+ 				  system_priority_file,
+ 				  (unsigned long long)sb.st_mtime);
+-- 
+2.43.0
+
